item.title: Trailer Space #54 - Between Collecting, Curating, and Creating Generative AI Art with Danielle King
item.description:
🎨 Check out the full episode here - https://youtu.be/18ofQDhLx_M
In this episode, we chat with Danielle King, an artist, collector, writer, and curator in the digital art space about her journey into the world of web3 and NFTs. Danielle highlights the importance of supporting artists and promoting underrepresented voices in the space. She also discusses her personal goals as an artist and her approach to collecting and curating art.
Danielle was the former manager of the Department of Painting and Sculpture at the Museum of Modern Art in New York and is currently the CFO & COO of ClubNFT and Right Click Save.

item.description:

item.title: Space #45 - The Nature of Art with Eislyn, AlyAsh, and ArtMis
item.description:
In this episode we welcome some of our favorite artists from the Angels' Wing - Eislyn, AlyAsh and ArtMis, to ruminate about the philosophy of art and what actually makes art important. Join us for a fun chat where the conversation branches to fascinating side-topics you won't want to miss.
Don't miss out on these profound discussions. This conversation can inspire your own creative journey, help you appreciate the nuances of different art forms, and understand the role of art in establishing personal and shared connections.

item.title: Space #44 - 300 Days of Cubism with Jason Chambers
item.description:
In this episode, we had the pleasure to chat with Jason Chambers, a passionate cubist artist from South Carolina, about his "300 Days of Cubism" Collection and his latest book, "30 Days of Mindful Cubism". Jason also gave a glimpse into his journey and excitement for his next book, "Create, Sell, Repeat" about transforming a hobby into a successful art business. This book touches upon online art sales, social media usage, and gallery exhibitions.

item.title: Space #43 - The Power of Daily Practice with Sylvo, AlyAsh and ArtMis
item.description:
In this episode, we chat with some of our favorite Angels' Wing artists - Sylvo, AlyAsh and ArtMis on how they channel their own powers of daily practice in their art. item.title: Space #29 - What is Trash Art with Eric Rhodes (@ericprhodes) and Drea Jay (@EmpressTrash)
item.description:
What exactly is trash art? This question has been on our minds for a while and that's why we have invited two honourable artists to our show: Eric Rhodes (@ericprhodes on Twitter) and Drea Jay (@EmpressTrash on Twitter). In this episode, these two advocates of decentralised art share their passionate views on what (trash) art is and how each of them got into the NFT space.
Eric is a designer who became an award-winning artist that pioneered two crypto-native art movements. His art practice spans three areas of exploration: digital paintings exploring mental health themes, conceptual artwork around remix culture and art law, and experiments with AI and Web3 tech. He is also the host of the NFT podcast, The Outer Realm. Prior to Web3, Eric was a customer experience and service design expert leading programs at Twitter and Google.
Empress Trash (Drea Jay) is a multi versatile visual artist & nomad with her rottweiler Glitch. A lifelong artist, she earned her BFA in Painting, Drawing, and Animation/Design from the University of Iowa in 2014. Shortly after, she moved to the Bay Area which she assisted and worked alongside a multitude of local and international artists and shows including Ai Wei Wei’s show on Alcatraz, being a member of the Firehouse Art Collective run by Tom Franco, and running her own underground shows from her house. She started in crypto art in 2021 and since has been exhibited internationally including Paris, Palm Springs, Miami Art Basel, NYC, LA, SXSW and Ted Talks Conference in Vancouver. ​ CHAPTERS 0:00 - Space #29 - What is Trash Art with Eric Rhodes and Drea Jay 01:04 - Intro of Angels' Wing Gallery 04:14 - Eric shares his discovery of NFT art 05:45 - How Trash Art began 08:10 - What it means to be decentralized as an artist in a decentralised space 09:35 - What is the draw about Trash Art 10:45 - Background of the "anti-art" movement and precursor to Trash Art 12:10 - Trash Art as a reflection of today's times 13:31 - Debate about what Trash Art symbolises and what it means to represent the movement 17:42 - Value of art and what defines it 18:02 - Empress Trash introduces herself and her view of the movement 32:38 - The collection that is close to Eric's heart 33:14 - Debate about being banned by platforms and why it is problematic 34:35 - How art helps artist on a personal level 40:53 - Closing comments on art for ourselves

item.title: Space #28 - Hefty Art and M.H. Husain's "Fury" auction at Sotheby's
item.description:
In this issue, we interview the team from Hefty Art. We talk about their ambitious plans to disrupt the Indian and Asian art markets with NFTs. They are launching a new curated art platform that combines digital and physical ("phygital") art.
To kick off the project, they have a high-end art offering right away. Together with the reputable auction house Sotheby's, they are auctioning the masterpiece "Fury" by the artist Maqbool Fida Husain.
Maqbul Fida Husain was an Indian painter, graphic artist, photographer and filmmaker. He was one of the most renowned and internationally recognised Indian painters of the 20th century. His works are painted in a modified cubist style. Of course, we wondered together about the vibrant artwork of "Fury" and reflected on its impact.

item.title: Space #26 - NFT Lending and Market Dynamics with Daniel Tenner (@swombat)
item.description:
Daniel Tenner (@Swombat on Twitter) joins us for a part 2 to continue the exposition into the current state of NFT market and how projects are akin to start-ups and small businesses fundraising. Daniel is a serial entrepreneur and better known in the NFT space for his passion, analytics and views on the overall NFT market.
In this episode, a continuation of episode #23, Daniel provides fresh perspectives on NFT lending, which NFTs are actually blue chips, & how he values NFT projects. item.title: Space #22 - AI generated Art with Charles (@HODLFrance) & Jessica Salinas (@wondermundo)
item.description:
We continue our deep dive into AI generated art with two esteemed guests in Space #22 : Charles (@HODLFrance) and Jessica Salinas (@wondermundo). While both being established NFT artists, they took their own unique paths to get to where they are today. Have a listen to find out more about our talented guests and their collections.
Charles shares about his journey - being early in crypto & NFTs, and how it came full circle for him as he discovered AI art while working on his thesis of AI applications for radiology.
Jessica chats about how she began in NFTs through art therapy. It was then that she re-discovered the artist in herself and her passion for digital art, which naturally brought her to the world of NFTs.
